name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Family/Spousal Reunion

requirements.blocker_text: A temporary residence permit is issued to a foreigner staying more than 90 days/year in Belarus for the purpose of spousal or family reunion (Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens, Article 46).

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of family relationship
Sponsor's residence status or citizenship documentation

sources.title: LegislationLine (OSCE-affiliated legal database, hosting the official English translation) -- Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens and Persons without Citizenship in the Republic of Belarus (1993, as amended 2005), Article 46: temporary residence for spousal/family reunion grounds; Article 50: permanent residence for spouses/relatives of Belarusian citizens after marriage or family ties

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belarus). Treated LegislationLine's hosted translation as tier-1 per this dataset's convention for verbatim-legislation mirrors on established legal-database domains -- consistent with how GLOBALCIT-hosted texts have been treated for other countries in this dataset. This is a distinctly GENEROUS route by this dataset's standards: Article 50 (see by_permanent_residence.json) allows spouses/relatives of Belarusian citizens to reach PERMANENT residence directly, without first needing the standard 7-year track -- though the exact reduced timeframe for this specific spousal permanent-residence path was not stated as a precise figure in the source excerpt fetched, only that the category qualifies. work_rights modeled 'restricted' as a conservative default; the source did not explicitly detail work-rights scope for this specific permit category.
